title: Visible stock is not necessarily usable stock
claim: Visible WOOD totals overstated usable fuel. Three apparent indoor logs were workshop construction materials; two nearby surface logs had the construction flag. Additional loose logs were outside the allowed work area or high in trees. An inventory flag also described a weapon inside a bin, rather than a weapon held by a soldier.
reproduction: In a disposable backed-up fortress, compare visible stack amounts with construction/building references, ownership/reservations, container chains, actual positions, burrow membership and a few representative routes. Compare wood totals with installed autochop status before changing production.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
Native autochop status reported zero usable logs and 22 inaccessible logs while the custom visible-stock counter remained positive.
A pending tree job became reachable after a small burrow extension and produced ten new logs.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. Filtering construction materials improves a sensor but does not establish reachability or recipe eligibility. A positive route result alone does not establish burrow or material availability.
